marketing.title: Science, art and shared wonder
marketing.draft_copy: Join 80 adults for Science, art and shared wonder at Banksia Hall, with the art and observation workshop in the covered courtyard and a quiet-space option in the Paperbark Quiet Room. The draft programme includes welcome and wayfinding, short science talks, the workshop, and light refreshments and conversation. Setup and pack-down fit within the 18:00–21:00 venue booking.

assumptions: This is a fictional, local drafting fixture; no availability or cost is a real quote.

SRC-INK-01 models a donated volunteer plan: one lead facilitator for 3 hours, two speakers for 1.5 hours each, two arrival/wayfinding stewards for 3 hours each, and one quiet-room host for 2 hours (14 volunteer-hours total); real availability is unverified.
open_questions: A human would need to verify room layout and practical access details before any real-world use.
